source_name: Prace.centrum.cz — Brno regional listings
why_relevant: Portal-attached board reaching a different, more local candidate pool; back-office and administrative bank roles in Brno often appear here.

source_name: Statutární město Ostrava — tiskové zprávy (city press releases)
why_relevant: Cities announce investor arrivals and job-creation numbers ('v Ostravě vznikají nová pracovní místa') often before the employer's own PR; also names the specific centres (finance/accounting SSCs) locating in the city.

source_name: Invest in Ostrava — Business Service Centres directory
why_relevant: City investment agency maintains a roster of the ~49 business-service centres in Ostrava with their focus areas (financial/accounting, IT, customer support) — an actor map for which financial-sector back-offices sit in the region, and thus which employers to monitor on review sites.

source_name: ABSL Czech Republic — Business Services Sector reports
why_relevant: Annual sector report quantifies centres and headcount by city (Prague, Brno, Ostrava, Hradec Králové, Liberec) and by function; the single best baseline for judging whether a bank's regional hiring is normal or exceptional, and a pointer to named centre operators.

source_name: Expats.cz — ABSL / business-services tag (English-language CZ news)
why_relevant: English-language outlet covering the SSC/GBS labour market and interviewing sector leaders; useful for leadership-move and sector-narrative signals aimed at the international workforce that staffs regional centres.

source_name: Měšec.cz — bank employer/benefits and employee-rating features
why_relevant: Consumer-finance outlet that periodically synthesises employee ratings and benefits across CZ banks — a ready-made cross-bank comparison and a pointer back to the underlying review platforms; its comment threads also carry employee voice.

source_name: Eurofound European Restructuring Monitor — Czech records
why_relevant: Logs individual CZ restructuring events (site closures, mass layoffs, relocations) with employer, region and headcount, sourced largely from national/regional press — it turns scattered regional reporting into structured records and is a cross-check for anything the review sites hint at.

source_name: Reddit r/czech and r/CzechRepublic (employee/job discussion threads)
why_relevant: Where younger CZ white-collar staff discuss employers, pay and reorganisations candidly, often mixing cs and en; complements Atmoskop for firms with few reviews. Lowest signal-to-noise in the cell but occasionally the earliest mention.

source_name: Finextra Research — People channel
why_relevant: Dedicated people/appointments channel for banking and payments; carries vendor and bank press releases about senior hires including CEE payments roles, often the English-first record of a move announced by a foreign parent.

source_name: Finextra press-release wire (pressarticle)
why_relevant: Company-submitted releases published near-verbatim; the fastest English channel for payments-vendor and bank appointment announcements that never reach Czech media.

source_name: The Paypers
why_relevant: Payments-specific international outlet that covers European PSP/acquirer/fintech leadership changes and market entries; useful for CZ payments-side org changes (Comgate, GoPay, Global Payments/ČSOB JV, Worldline CEE).

source_name: bne IntelliNews — Czechia coverage
why_relevant: The strongest English-language CEE business desk; covers Czech bank ownership, IPOs, sector taxes and management reshuffles that Czech media report only in Czech.

source_name: SeeNews — Banking & Financial news
why_relevant: SEE/CEE business wire with a banking vertical; picks up Czech-linked corporate and subsidiary news. Caveat: its core geography is Southeast Europe, so CZ coverage is incidental rather than systematic.

source_name: Erste Group Bank AG — press releases
why_relevant: Parent of Česká spořitelna. Group-level CEO/management-board appointments for the Czech subsidiary are announced here in English, frequently before or instead of Czech-language coverage.

source_name: KBC Group newsroom
why_relevant: Parent of ČSOB. KBC announces the Czech Business Unit CEO and Executive Committee changes in English regulated releases — confirmed example: Aleš Blažek named CEO of ČSOB (2022).

source_name: Société Générale — press releases / newsroom
why_relevant: Parent of Komerční banka. Announces the KB Chairman/CEO and 'Group Country Head for Czech Republic and Slovakia' role — a group-level construct that defines the CZ country organisation and is only visible in the parent's English releases.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank International — media hub / press releases
why_relevant: Parent of Raiffeisenbank a.s. (CZ). Group management-board reorganisations and network-bank appointments are published in English; CZ CFO/board appointments have appeared through RBI ad-hoc disclosure.

source_name: EQS News — ad-hoc regulated announcements
why_relevant: Regulated ad-hoc disclosure wire used by Austrian/German-listed parents (RBI, Erste). Board appointments touching CZ subsidiaries appear here first, timestamped and structured.

source_name: GlobeNewswire (parent-bank release mirror)
why_relevant: Mirrors KBC and other parents' regulated releases in a stable, machine-friendly format — a resilient fallback when a corporate newsroom page is later removed after a departure.

source_name: Euronext company-news feed
why_relevant: Exchange-hosted copy of KBC (and other Euronext-listed parents') regulated announcements; independent of the company's own website lifecycle.

source_name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine (+ CDX API)
why_relevant: Core archive capability for this cell: preserves management/board pages of CZ banks and PSPs that are edited or deleted after a departure. Diffing successive snapshots of e.g. rb.cz bank-management or csob.cz vedení pages detects unannounced org changes.

source_name: Raiffeisenbank a.s. (CZ) — Bank Management page (EN)
why_relevant: English-language roster of the Czech bank's management board — the canonical target for archive-diff monitoring; changes here often precede any public announcement.

source_name: Central Banking — Czech Republic region page
why_relevant: English specialist outlet tracking ČNB board appointments, governor/deputy-governor changes and supervisory reorganisations — the regulator side of the A5 people picture.

source_name: Euromoney — CEE banking coverage and awards
why_relevant: Awards and CEE profiles name the executives running country units and describe reorganisations; useful for reconstructing who owns which CZ business line when banks do not publish org charts.

source_name: Expats.cz — banking tag (English news about Czechia)
why_relevant: English-language Prague outlet that translates and summarises Czech banking news for a foreign audience; a cheap bridge when a move is reported only in Czech media.

source_name: FinTech Futures — Europe / people coverage
why_relevant: Long-running English fintech/banking-tech outlet covering vendor and bank appointments and core-banking programme leadership; catches payments-org changes in CEE that general media miss.

source_name: IBS Intelligence (IBSi)
why_relevant: Banking-technology research and news outlet; covers vendor/bank leadership and programme-ownership changes relevant to CZ payments infrastructure decisions.

source_name: MarketScreener — issuer profile and press-release feeds
why_relevant: Aggregates board/management rosters and press releases for listed CZ banks (Komerční banka, Moneta) and their parents in English; convenient snapshot of who currently sits on the board.

source_name: The Official Board — Raiffeisenbank Czech Republic org chart & news
why_relevant: Commercial org-chart database that reconstructs reporting lines and flags executive changes for CZ bank subsidiaries — one of the few English sources that models organisation structure, not just headlines.

source_name: GlobalData — Komerční banka executive & employee information
why_relevant: Commercial company-intelligence profile listing executives and role histories for CZ banks; useful cross-check on titles and tenure dates.
